# Shopify FAQ + GEO Injector (shopify-faq-geo)

> 100% Free & Open Source tool to turn negative 1–3 star buyer reviews and pre-purchase objections into 12 high-converting Shopify product page FAQs (EN/DE/JP), zero-error Schema.org `FAQPage` JSON-LD, and ready-to-paste Shopify Online Store 2.0 `sections/faq-geo.liquid` accordion components.

## Core Capabilities
- **6-Axis Buyer Friction Clustering**: Automatically clusters raw review CSVs or plain text across Sizing & Compatibility, Shipping & Packaging, Battery & Durability, Returns & Warranty, Material & Safety, and Setup & Usability.
- **Zero-Error `FAQPage` JSON-LD**: Produces clean, validated `https://schema.org` structured data ready for Google Rich Results, ChatGPT Shopping, Perplexity, and Claude citations.
- **Zero-Monthly-Fee Shopify `.liquid` Component**: Generates a drop-in `sections/faq-geo.liquid` OS 2.0 section with customizable styling and automatic `strip_html | json` JSON-LD rendering.
- **Multi-Market Localization**: Free instant export in English (US/UK), German (DE/AT), and Japanese (JP).
